name: Dropbox Sign
label: Dropbox Sign API v3
description: Dropbox Sign API v3. Official API https://developers.hellosign.com/api/reference/overview/. One node; pick operation. Handler: OfficialApiNode + api_spec.json. HelloSign product brand retired; terms are Dropbox Sign. Developer host remains api.hellosign.com/v3. signature_request_files OUTPUT is type file. Customer is the sender.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put secrets on this port.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation. Accepted: signature_request_send, signature_request_get, signature_request_list, signature_request_cancel, signature_request_files, template_get, template_list, template_delete, listen.

schema.label: title
schema.description: Document title for signature_request_send.

schema.label: subject
schema.description: Email subject for signature_request_send.

schema.label: signers
schema.description: signature_request_send signers: [{email_address, name, order}]. Required. Official signers.

schema.label: signature_request_id
schema.description: URL path parameter `signature_request_id` for operations: signature_request_get, signature_request_cancel, signature_request_files. Required by: signature_request_get, signature_request_cancel, signature_request_files.

schema.label: page
schema.description: Query-string parameter `page` for operations: signature_request_list, template_list.

schema.label: page_size
schema.description: Query-string parameter `page_size` for operations: signature_request_list, template_list.

schema.label: file_type
schema.description: Query-string parameter `file_type` for operation: signature_request_files.

schema.label: template_id
schema.description: URL path parameter `template_id` for operations: template_get, template_delete. Required by: template_get, template_delete.

schema.label: message
schema.description: Email message for signature_request_send.

schema.label: file_urls
schema.description: Remote file URLs for signature_request_send (file_url[]). Official file_urls.

schema.label: cc_email_addresses
schema.description: CC emails for signature_request_send.

schema.label: test_mode
schema.description: When true, signature_request_send is test (no credits).

schema.label: signing_redirect_url
schema.description: Redirect after signing.

schema.label: metadata
schema.description: signature_request_send metadata map.

schema.label: client_id
schema.description: OAuth app client id when sending on behalf of a user.

schema.label: use_text_tags
schema.description: Parse text tags in the document.

schema.label: hide_text_tags
schema.description: Hide text tags (with use_text_tags).

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success {status, http_status, data, file?}. Secrets redacted. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: ok on success.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body or text.

schema.label: file
schema.description: Downloaded or converted bytes. Platform file ref-id (sq-file: / sq-ref:gridfs:). Never inline bytes or base64 as the stored type.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Official HTTP verb for this invoke. listen/webhook_listen are ingress — use a BPMN message event.

configurationParameters.label: Api Key
configurationParameters.description: Dropbox Sign API key (HTTP Basic username, empty password), minted outside StudioQuack. StudioQuack secret binding. Never log.
